messages.text:
I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore. Could you bring that back and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Arrow-key navigation is restored. Unmodified arrow keys move focus within the current row or column and stop at board edges. Modified keys are left to the browser; Enter and Space still use native button activation. The board navigation is in [Card.tsx](/work/src/game/board/Card.tsx:43), [Board.tsx](/work/src/game/board/Board.tsx:43), and [keyboard-movement.ts](/work/src/game/board/keyboard-movement.ts:1).

Verification passed: type checking, all 141 unit tests, and all 75 browser journeys on the project’s named runtime. The changed files pass Prettier. The repository-wide format check still reports 13 files outside this change. A screen reader was not used; the README records spoken-output review as part of user acceptance.
